title: Jefferson booking records show 6 people processed on June 8
text:
A minimum of 6 people were processed at Jefferson, AL detention facilities on June 8, 2026, with bookings spanning two separate locations.
The ‘Drug’ and ‘Other’ charge categories each appeared in 3 different entries. Categories marked ‘Property’ and ‘Violent’ were each seen in 2 listings, while ‘Warrant’ appeared once. “POSSESSION OF CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE – HALLUCINOGEN – POSSESS” was recorded as the most frequent charge, listed 3 times.
Charges reflect those on record at the time of each booking. The listed individuals have not necessarily been convicted based on this report.
